title: Crossing
suits: exchanges, marketplaces, escrow, atomic swaps, payments for access: two parties trade and neither goes first

params.--field / --brand / --brand-2: field; the seller's shirt, the key and the seal (brand); the buyer's shirt (brand-2)
params.B / S / C1 / C2: hand positions and the arc's control points (script); the key's arc is the coin's mirror image

details: both people lean back to wind up, then lean in on the throw, then settle
the two arcs are mirror images, so the coin and the key meet exactly mid-air at the same instant
a white flash and an expanding ring where they cross
the product's mark is left at the crossing as a small seal, which pops with an overshoot and stays
the coin flips edge-on and back four times as it flies; the key tumbles once
dotted trails are revealed behind each flight and stay as the picture of the swap
two floor shadows travel underneath, smaller and fainter the higher the things are
the receiving hand dips with the weight on the catch and comes back up
each person's eyes follow the thing coming to them
after the catch both tilt their heads to look at what they got
the counters are stalls: a lit top edge, a planked skirt in each side's colour
a soft pool of light behind the crossing
